article.title: Iterable公布託管連接器，讓行銷團隊在AI工具籌備活動
article.summary: Iterable開放託管連接器試用，支援在Claude、ChatGPT及Cursor籌備行銷流程。
highlights: 行銷人員用自己的Iterable帳戶登入，沿用既有角色權限。
試用須向Iterable客戶經理查詢。
article.why: 客戶關係管理團隊可先評估活動草擬和審批能否沿用現有分工。
article.next_step: 用唯讀權限試查一項活動，確認哪些職位可查看資料或改動流程。
article.detail: Iterable透過模型情境協定（MCP）把平台接到三款AI工具。公告描述可由構思走到待上線的行銷流程，操作受登入者的角色權限約束。官方社群資料列明現階段提供試用，團隊可向客戶經理確認細節。安排試用時，可先用不涉及個人資料的活動範本，記錄哪些操作需要人工批准。
article.title_en: Iterable introduces a hosted connector for planning campaigns in AI tools
article.summary_en: Iterable opened a trial of a hosted connector for campaign workflows in Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor.
highlights_en: Marketers sign in with their own Iterable accounts and keep their existing role permissions.
Contact an Iterable account representative about the trial.
article.why_en: CRM teams can assess whether campaign drafting and approvals fit their current roles.
article.next_step_en: Check one campaign with read-only access and identify who can view data or change workflows.
article.detail_en: Iterable connects its platform to three AI tools via Model Context Protocol, or MCP. It describes a workflow from an idea to a launch-ready journey, subject to the signed-in user's role. The community FAQ says access is in trial through account representatives. Start with a template that contains no personal data and document which actions need human approval.
